g.text: Keyboard shortcuts — Tab / arrows / PageUp / PageDown to navigate
? opens help outside editable text. F1 opens help anywhere; Esc closes it.
Single-letter app shortcuts apply outside text inputs. Ctrl+Q always quits.
Ctrl+D toggles a skill on the workbench; inside editors it edits text normally.
Tab / Shift+Tab move focus. Enter activates the focused command or button.
Workbench tree: Down opens a collapsed node, otherwise advances; Up goes back.
Left collapses / goes to parent; Right opens / enters children / focuses files.
Menus: Down opens / advances; Up moves back; Left returns; Right opens.
App arrow navigation overrides native tree arrows below. Editors keep native arrows.
Read-only displays ignore editing actions. Native bindings apply when that control has focus.
